lines.text: Tobi had been at his new school for exactly one week, when they called him a thief.
It started with notes. The teacher told the class to borrow notes from the other arm, to complete their own.
Tobi borrowed Kemi's.
The next morning, Kemi came to collect it. She searched his bag. Her note was gone.
But his classmates laughed.
You already took it back yesterday! We all saw you!
lines.speaker: classmate

lines.text: Later that day, Kemi burst into his class.
My money is gone! Somebody stole my money!
lines.speaker: kemi

lines.text: And she pointed straight at the new boy.
They searched his bag. Inside, exactly the amount she lost.
Tobi stayed calm.
What notes were they?
lines.speaker: tobi

lines.text: One thousand naira. One single note.
lines.speaker: kemi

lines.text: Tobi smiled, and pulled out two five-hundreds.
Then you changed it! You are still a thief!
lines.speaker: kemi

lines.text: The teachers came. They searched his pockets, and found even more money.
Where did a new boy get all this? You stole from home too!
lines.speaker: teacher

lines.text: Then the school president, the biggest boy in the whole school, leaned in.
Thief.
lines.speaker: president

lines.text: In the principal's office, they finally called his father.
Sir, how much did you give your son today?
lines.speaker: principal

lines.text: One thousand five hundred. Two five-hundreds for lunch, and five hundred for transport.
lines.speaker: dad

lines.text: Exactly what was in his bag, and his pocket. The room went silent.
A week later, the truth came out. Another girl in his class had taken Kemi's money, just to teach her a lesson.
